newsitem.title: JAPAN: Croatia seeks stronger economic ties with Asia.
newsitem.headline: Croatia seeks stronger economic ties with Asia.

text.p: Croatia's Foreign and Deputy Prime Minister Mate Granic said on Tuesday his country aims to strengthen economic ties with Asia while it awaits official admission into the European Union (EU).

"We have interest in strong economic cooperation with Asian countries because the process of European integration can be a long process. We need additional presence with foreign investment in Croatia," Granic said at a news conference in Tokyo.

When asked about Croatian-Taiwanese relations, he said: "Concerning Taiwan, we have good relations with China, and we support China as one country. But we are ready to develop economic relations with Taiwan."
The Council of Europe admitted the young republic as its 40th member state in October, opening the door to EU aid and trade schemes.
Granic told reporters his country expects to achieve official EU member status in five or six years.
Granic leaves Japan on Wednesday after a four-day visit.
